notes.title: Update 24.06.13
notes.content:
Hi, everybody!

I got so many feedback for 3 days, because I joined Steam Next Fest.

So I wanted to update quickly.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that the game resumes if you press spacebar in level up.
[*] You can skip card shuffling animation by pressing spacebar.
[*] Reduced Bell explosion sound
[*] Changed Coin sound
[*] Add Card Description in Card Deck Screen
[/list]

Thank you for reading.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update 2023.12.21
notes.content:
Hi, everybody!

I changed all playable characters.

Now they are not normal cats. They are robot pirate cats now.

And I added Feedback system.

You can send a message anytime to us.

Just press F12.
